title: Export from each tab holds only that tab's parts
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Inventory parts {Part-A} and {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-EXP-01 and -02) are active at {Location-A}.
  • Inventory part {Part-C} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-EXP-03) is inactive at {Location-A}.
  • All three part numbers start with {Prefix-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-EXP).
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  2. Type {Prefix-A} in the Search box.
  3. Click the ⋮ actions menu button in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  4. Click Export.
  5. Open the downloaded file and look for {Part-A}, {Part-B} and {Part-C}.
  6. Click the Inactive tab.
  7. Type {Prefix-A} in the Search box, replacing any text there.
  8. Click the ⋮ actions menu button.
  9. Click Export.
  10. Open the second downloaded file and look for {Part-A}, {Part-B} and {Part-C}.
  11. Pick up to 3 other part numbers from the second file and search for each on the Inactive tab.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: A file downloads.
  • Step 5: The file from the Active tab holds {Part-A} and {Part-B} and does not hold {Part-C}.
  • Step 9: A second file downloads.
  • Step 10: The file from the Inactive tab holds {Part-C} and does not hold {Part-A} or {Part-B}.
  • Step 11: Every part number picked from the second file is found on the Inactive tab: the Inactive export holds only inactive parts.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10814 (Story 1, Active and Inactive Tabs on the Inventory List); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S1-R9, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 4.1 (The actions menu), 13 Oct copy.
